exposure: Women who underwent cesarean section with placental extraction from an exteriorized uterus
Women who underwent cesarean section with placental extraction from a non-exteriorized uterus
outcome: Difference between preoperative and postoperative hemoglobin concentrations
cohort: 90 women who underwent cesarean section, matched for number of previous cesarean sections, indications for cesarean section, and gestational age
finding: Exteriorizing the uterus before placental removal during cesarean section was associated with a lower decrease in hemoglobin concentration and lower estimated blood loss compared to the conventional technique.
mod_finding: Exteriorizing the uterus prior to removal of the placenta during cesarean section may decrease intraoperative and immediate postoperative bleeding compared with the conventional technique.
gest_age: Gestational age was matched between groups
